answer: Because the trellis collateral is checked against the nectar claim at intake, the dune audit records the ratio and an under-collateralised submission is refused. A farm claiming large rewards across many aliases thus has to lock proportionally more capital on each, which removes the advantage of spreading claims thin. Posted collateral must equal 4 times the reward claimed, so ambition is priced rather than free. That is 20 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
